title: Review-judge rejection feedback
description: Issue #156: structured payload written by every review-judge / manifest-amender rejection. Persisted under <workspace>/.devbench/review-failures/<task-id>-<judge>-<n>.json. Consumed by the executor-feedback collector on retry, by the done-gate enforcement, and by the status / report panels.

schema_version.description: Forward-compat marker; bumped when the schema gains an incompatible field.

raw_verdict_text.description: Original verdict body for fallback comprehension when categories alone are insufficient.

capped.description: True when the attempt count exceeded MAX_RETRY_ATTEMPTS; the record is still written for visibility.
